name: ai-compute-observability-solu2
description: Module 11 - AI Infrastructure Observability Console (Impl-1 Implementation): Clean Architecture / Hexagonal Ports & Adapters, in-memory ring buffer, SQLite persistence, HTTP REST API, 100% green ATDD suite.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node -e "fs.writeFileSync('dist/package.json', JSON.stringify({ type: 'commonjs' })); fs.cpSync('src/adapters/inbound/ui', 'dist/src/adapters/inbound/ui', { recursive: true })"
scripts.test:all: vitest run --config test/vitest.harness.config.ts && vitest run --config test/vitest.atdd.config.ts
scripts.ci:full: npm run ci && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:e2e
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run test:all && npm run trace:check && npm run readiness:check
